tools.name: get_meter_balance
tools.description: Get the current prepaid credit balance of a meter, in SGD.

tools.name: get_meter_usage
tools.description: Get up to 7 days of usage for an NUS meter, with spending analysis, month-to-date spending, and how long the balance may last. Amounts are in SGD. Dates are as EVS reports them, with no time zone, and recent days may be missing. Not available for SUTD meters.

tools.name: get_recent_topups
tools.description: Get up to 10 recent top-ups for a meter. To confirm a payment, look for a top-up with the same amount dated after the createdAt of its link, and with no status showing it failed. tools.name: get_topup_link
tools.description: Create a link to the secure top-up page, for the user to open and pay by card themselves. Creating the link charges nothing. Refuses a meter EVS doesn't recognise.
